summary: Program attempts propagate durable W3C trace correlation through isolated workers and exec subprocesses, with bounded root spans, retry links, and ERROR status for daemon-refused requests or result journals

replay.detail: New program journal/result claims reference the exact launch's durable program.attempt.trace claim ID through the existing evidence[] envelope field; program.step fields keep their old shape, without an inline trace object. Historical journals remain valid. mission.run.trace and program.attempt.trace claims retain correlation independently of trace sampling.

schema.detail: Registers durable system-only mission.run.trace and program.attempt.trace claims; program.step fields are unchanged and no SQL migration is required.

rules.detail: No authority grants or mission outcome rules change.

compatibility.detail: Older readers admit the unchanged program journal shape and retain unknown standalone trace claim kinds; no reader-first deployment is required. Program worker and exec environments receive TRACEPARENT and TRACESTATE. Native harness telemetry only continues this parent when the harness supports extraction; receiving env is not proof of native harness span continuity.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon deployment without a reader-first gate; existing program journals replay unchanged.

manual.detail: No new telemetry endpoint or sampler configuration.

recovery.detail: Host replacement closes the old attempt span and links a fresh root to its durable correlation.
